author: HCDE
text:
Hi Constantine, Nowadays, FL and kink are considered as the same thing. When IF came up with FL concept, it was mostly equivalent to what he now calls "S/R kink", so some people still call S/R kink a FL. But essentially FL and kinks are the same thing, though kink is a more complete / comprehensive concept.

So to answer your question, your phrases seem correct to me, the two first one beeing in fact the same ones.

author: dkd11
text:
Past. study the zone in all TFs, down to M1 ask yourself Where were the decisions made? Clean S/D? Mark these lines. No clean S/D? – compressed zone Did price really shoot away form the zone, or did it cp away? Did the zone itself react at the right place? Look beyond the zone further into the past. See what it reacted to. Was there a better S/D nearby that price wants to visit? This explains many fakeouts. Did price originally react to the RS of a Flag Limit? It can fakeout to true SD of the FL.

What is necessary to trade this Kink? For a start, it is necessary to know that we have to wait in this zone. that is "approach" and "reaction". So Present. Approach. How is price returning to the zone?

Where’s the nearest flag in the TF you want to trade? This is your tg1 in this TF. Flags in the LTFs? What does PA tell you? Has price tested the last flag on approach? (good sign) Has price compressed into the zone in this TF or LTFs? (good sign) Is there big news on the way? Has there just been big news? 1- Where’s the nearest flag in the TF you want to trade? If at us monthly kink, means we have to trade on the day chart. (Why not? =) ) It turns out, the first that we have to wait for is a Flag on the day schedule. But from where we have to form it? How do we have to form it? How do we learn where there is a purpose of this flag? All this to us will be answered by PA!

But at the same time, we have a break on the Daily chart. That says this zone we can trade too. We have to wait for a flag on H1 Where’s the nearest flag in the TF you want to trade? This is your tg1 in this TF. Flags in the LTFs? It turns out that the price has to estimate this flag, to be exact the price has to fulfill this flag. So, we have to form a flag on H1 and trade above this flag for the purpose of inside new flag. look:

we will consider our daily Kink in more detail:
